newsitem.title: USA: ESPN buys sports arm of Argentina Telesport.
newsitem.headline: ESPN buys sports arm of Argentina Telesport.

text.p: ESPN Inc on Monday said it bought the sports production and distribution arm of Telesport SA of Argentina.

ESPN, a sports cable network that is part of Walt Disney Co's ABC Inc subsidiary, said the unit's programming reached audiences in Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay. Since its creation in 1989, the arm has become a major producer, distributor and rights acquisition holder of various sporting events in Latin America, it added.
ESPN, which did not give the value of the deal, said it would rename the business ESPN Sur.
